thread:
elaine: Noticed screen reader verbosity in run history tool calls. Anyone have quick fixes we can patch this week?

mike: Yes. Currenly SR reads entire args. Suggest a concise aria-label and an explicit 'Show details' control.

sam: Short label idea: 'Tool call: {toolName}  {briefResult}' and keep args in an expandable region. Skip repeating timestamps in label.

nisha: Example aria-label we tested: "Tool call by Elaine: fetch_weather  returned: sunny, 72F". Details region uses aria-labelledby to point back.

jordan: Will test VoiceOver with that. Also: signature pill wrapping breaks flow. Truncate signature and expose full via tooltip + aria-describedby.

mike: Copy nit: change button from 'Show tool output' to 'Show outputs (N)'. Less ambiguous when there are multiple outputs.

sam: On schema editor, inline JSON edits dump the whole schema to SR. Let's surface Name/Description/Params as labeled inputs and put raw JSON behind 'View full schema' dialog with role=dialog.

jordan: Dialog checklist: aria-modal, focus trap, heading first, Escape closes. I'll validate NVDA/VO after patch.

aria-bot: Accessibility smoke run queued for staging after PR #3435 lands.

devops-bot: deploy to staging triggered by @sam  build 2025.02.1 (ci-9150)

elaine: Plan: land aria-label + outputs-count + signature truncation this week. Editor refactor next sprint. Sam to create copy + test PRs. Jordan to validate on mac/win.

sam: Opening PRs now, adding automated SR test for aria-label shape and labelled detail region.

jordan: I'll report any oddities after the smoke run.

elaine: Thanks everyone, leaving notes in the design ticket with examples. If bots show failures drop logs here. :slightly_smiling_face:
